# Digitize me

> AI-powered document management and OCR platform for the UAE and Middle East. Arabic & English OCR, auto-classification, and full-text search across millions of pages.

Digitize me (by Infasme) helps businesses turn paper and digital documents into a searchable, secure archive. Compatible with Google Drive and OneDrive, setup in about two minutes.
